items.item_text: Background Check: Continued employment is contingent upon the completion of a satisfactory background investigation.
Master's Degree MPH degree or equivalent combination of education and experience
2 years Experience working in global health research projects, surveillance, or in apublic health role on communicable diseases or emerging infectious diseases.
2 years Experience writing or supporting 1) research protocols, 2) IRB submissions, and/or 3) grant applications.
2 years Experience with quantitative survey design for epidemiologic research.
2 years Experience working in a laboratory or with laboratory data, specificallyserologic assay data.
2 years Experience in data analysis using R or SAS.
Experience in manuscript writing for scientific publication.

We are seeking a Research Data Analyst 3 to support a variety of research projects and activities. The position will work collaboratively with research teams and contribute to study coordination, data analysis, and assist in preparing research findings.
Ability to coordinate progress with multiple stakeholders
Extensive knowledge of emerging infectious diseases, including mpox Ebola, and vaccine preventable diseases including polio and measles.
Knowledge of data analysis methods including, regression and maximum likelihood estimation, survival analysis, multilevel modelling, and other key epidemiological analyses.
Ability to work independently, under tight deadlines.
Ability to interact diplomatically, yet effectively with individuals from various social, cultural and ethnic backgrounds.
Ability to develop and deliver incisive, coherent presentations; ability to articulate clearly
